subject: maths
question: Which of the following chemicals is NOT added to ordinary water for making brine solution?
solution:
The correct answer is __Hydrochloric acid**(HCl)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Hydrochloric acid__ is not used in making brine solution.
 
• Brine solution is typically made by dissolving sodium chloride (common salt) in water.
 
• Other components like propylene glycol or ethylene glycol may be added for specific applications.
 
• Hydrochloric acid is a strong acid used in industrial processes but not for brine preparation.
 
• Brine is commonly used in food preservation, refrigeration, and industrial processes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Sodium Chloride:**

 
 
• Commonly known as table salt, it is the main ingredient in brine.
 
• It is readily soluble in water to form a saline solution.
 
 
 
• **Propylene Glycol:**
 
 
• Used in brine for specific industrial applications, such as refrigeration systems.
 
• It acts as an anti-freeze agent and lowers the freezing point of the solution.
 
 
 
• **Ethylene Glycol:**
 
 
• Similar to propylene glycol, it is also used as an anti-freeze agent in brine solutions.
 
• It is commonly used in industrial cooling systems.
